repairs.reason: Six required legs are not visible; only four separated supports are established.
repairs.edit: Repose this SAME stone lift beetle so exactly SIX legs are fully visible and separately countable: three legs attached along each side of the body, six separate broad flat feet, visible gaps between every foot. Raise the oval shell and use a slightly elevated three-quarter view that reveals the three far-side legs instead of hiding them behind the shell. Keep one small paving slab on its shell and the blunt shovel mouth. No additional limbs, antennae or tail.
repairs.preserve: Mint-gray stone shell, cream wedge face and dark eyes, simple outlined adventure-comic treatment, restrained warm ground, original species identity. Adjust pose and camera only as needed to establish all six supports.

repairs.reason: Fourth rear foot is hidden and a visible foot has four pads instead of the specified three.

Each foot has exactly THREE broad rounded toe pads. Use a slightly elevated view and move the far rear leg out from behind its torso so the entire foot is exposed. Retain one complete tapering tail. Reduce internal facet breakup to a few broad glass planes so leg attachments remain clear.
repairs.preserve: Same low reptile, broad head, two cyan disc eyes, restrained inner cyan charge line, crisp Nightglass rendering, dark glass material and overall identity. No extra fins, limbs, frills or props.

Remove any extra foot-shaped form under the body or beside the tail. Exactly one small ROUND tail; no elongated second tail. Keep both huge leaf-shaped ears fully visible.
repairs.preserve: Same sandy ceramic rabbit, blue glazed leaf ears, expressive round dark eyes, warm outlined painted treatment and quiet ochre ground. Do not redesign its face or add new gear.
